c03_full_name.text: Hospital HR: their records list him as Ravi Sadashiva Shetty. The "S." is his father's name. Same person.

c03_ransomware.text: News: during the 2023 ransomware attack on Coastal Care, in-house IT supervisor Ravi Shetty restored critical systems from offline backups within 14 hours. No patient data was lost.

c03_hospital_ref.text: Hospital HR: "We would rehire him in a heartbeat. The new owners didn't keep anyone local."

c03_rao_ransomware.text: Dr. Rao confirms he worked 30 hours straight during the attack and refused the bonus, asking that it go to the night nurses.

c03_blunt.text: Dr. Rao: "He is blunt with management. Never with patients or staff."

c03_lfcs.text: Linux Foundation registry: LFCS certification for Ravi Shetty (2021) is valid.

c03_forum_rant.text: An angry forum post by "ravi_s" complains that IT staff are "treated like peons by management".

search.title: Hospital back online in 14 hours after ransomware attack
search.snippet: Coastal Care credits in-house IT supervisor Ravi Shetty, who restored systems from offline backups...
search.body: MANGALURU, August 2023. Coastal Care Hospitals restored its admissions, pharmacy and lab systems within 14 hours of a ransomware attack that crippled two other hospitals in the region. Administrators credited IT supervisor Ravi Shetty, who had insisted on weekly offline backups 'that nobody thought we needed'. No patient data was lost.

search.title: National chain acquires Coastal Care; back-office to be centralised
search.snippet: Local IT, billing and HR roles will move to the Chennai headquarters...
search.body: Coastal Care Hospitals has been acquired by MediLine Health. Back-office functions including IT, billing and HR will be centralised in Chennai by October 2026.
